measurement_notes: latency histograms contain only measurement-cohort echoes that completed in-window; completion timestamps are captured after the successful send/recv return; frames returned in one recv chunk share that single post-recv completion time; sampling aggregates are bounded by the observed measurement aperture (explicit start/end boundary tick observations, observed timestamps and boundary lag disclosed; not exact scheduled-window isolation), VmHWM is the process lifetime high-water mark; no invented latency threshold is applied.
